name: Burton Osbourne
source:
MBTI: ISTJ

"However, as long as all of you don't intend to get in my way, I suppose we shouldn't have an issue."

The pragmatic inventor with little patience for others' incompetence. Burton appears harsh and blunt and his behavior doesn't seem to suggest otherwise. Claiming to remember only returning back from a class, Burton seems to have no idea what might've led to their situation. Although cooperation doesn't seem to be his forte, Burton only requests everyone stay out of his way.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
